title: feat(gen): publish a Bring Your Own Pollen agent skill
author: newyanr

gist.summary: Added a discoverable Bring Your Own Pollen agent skill at /.well-known/agent-skills/bring-your-own-pollen/SKILL.md, listed in the Agent Skills index and llms.txt. It guides coding agents through user-paid sign-in: OAuth authorization-code with PKCE for new web apps, the legacy fragment flow, and device authorization for headless apps. It documents App Key creation, exact redirect URI matching, earnings opt-in, scopes, budget and expiry restrictions, token exchange and polling, userinfo, and the absence of refresh tokens. CI and deployment workflows now track changes to the skill source.
